items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: I played with Bix Beiderbecke in the Goldkette band for about nine months out of his short life.

ctx.x: 1927 Yeah. See the Goldkette band split for a reference number say Labor Day of 1927. That is when the Goldkette, the Victor band I mean that it was known, and so my portion, but I played with Bix Beiderbecke in the Goldkette band for about nine months out of his short life. He died when he was 28 and if he’d a hung out with me, he’d a been 92 now too.
You know Bix didn’t play with a lot of notes, but what a style, what a style. Beautiful. He swung.
